text: Law is a discipline that takes legal phenomena and their laws as its research object, aiming to systematically explain legal principles, rules and practical logic, and cultivate professional talents with legal thinking, practical ability and social responsibility. Through course study, students will master the core framework of the legal system, understand the interactive relationship between law and society, economy and politics, possess the ability to analyze and solve practical problems using law, and be competent for work in fields such as legal practice, academic research and public affairs.
